summary: Queued a probe for the one limitation the parent configuration account still lists about breadth: whether the gap depends on the log store shape. The probe writes the same single-node history (configuration entry at index 1, ten commands, staged commit index) into a commit-tracking store that also reports itself as monotonic, then constructs the node from it with RestoreCommittedLogs and no snapshot. Locally the recovered configuration came back empty with the applied index at the staged commit index, so the gap appears with that store shape too; that receipt is unread, so the account keeps its store-breadth limitation until it is read.
